title: Japanese Vowel Length Acoustic Data / Acoustic characteristics of Japanese short and long vowels: Formant displacement effect revisited
task: nonce-word reading in isolation and carrier sentence
annotation_target: V1 onset/offset; F1/F2 midpoint; F1/F2 at 30 equally spaced points over central 20-80%
manual_scope: SPPAS-proposed vowel boundaries manually modified in Praat to first/last positive zero crossings for every analyzed token
decision_reason: Primary controlled production with exhaustive manual correction of target-vowel boundaries, explicit C1/V1/C2/V2 context, and dense within-vowel F1/F2 trajectories.
evidence_summary: ICPhS methods state vowel boundaries were first determined automatically with SPPAS and then manually modified in Praat; Zenodo release documents 16 speakers, C1V1C2V2 materials, and 30 within-vowel F1/F2 samples plus midpoint values.
